cleanup_interruption.block_sql: CREATE FUNCTION pause_statistics_cleanup() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM pg_sleep(30); RETURN NULL; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER pause_statistics_cleanup BEFORE DELETE ON sqb_warehouse_statistics FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION pause_statistics_cleanup();
cleanup_interruption.wait_sql: DO $$ DECLARE deadline timestamptz := clock_timestamp() + interval '5 seconds'; BEGIN WHILE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid=l.pid WHERE l.relation='sqb_warehouse_statistics'::regclass AND a.wait_event='PgSleep' AND a.query LIKE 'DELETE FROM sqb_warehouse_statistics%') LOOP IF clock_timestamp() >= deadline THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cleanup did not start'; END IF; PERFORM pg_stat_clear_snapshot(); PERFORM pg_sleep(0.02); END LOOP; END $$;
cleanup_interruption.restore_sql: SELECT pg_cancel_backend(a.pid) FROM pg_stat_activity a JOIN pg_locks l ON l.pid=a.pid WHERE l.relation='sqb_warehouse_statistics'::regclass AND a.wait_event='PgSleep' AND a.query LIKE 'DELETE FROM sqb_warehouse_statistics%'; DROP TRIGGER pause_statistics_cleanup ON sqb_warehouse_statistics; DROP FUNCTION pause_statistics_cleanup();
